messages:
ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw a recurring pattern: wide feature-flag rollout + insufficient canary gates -> rapid blast radius. Need a compact remediation plan and clear owners. TL;DR proposed sprint items below, please pick owners and ETA.

ashley: Proposed items (short):
- Auto-rollback policy for feature flags (thresholds, sampling ramp, cooldown)
- Flag scoping templates (segmenting by region/customer-tier/% rollout, default safe scopes)
- Canary health gates in CI (error-rate, p95 latency, anomaly lookback)
- Per-flag telemetry + activation histograms + burn-rate alerts
- Ops kill-switch dashboard + runbook updates

ben: I can own Auto-rollback policy.
ben: proposal: rollback when 5xx rate > 3% above baseline for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline sustained for 5m. Default sample ramp: 1% -> 10% over 30m. Cooldown: 10m.
ben: Example config snippet (draft):
```yaml
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  cooldown_mins: 10
  triggers:
    - type: error_rate
      pct_above_baseline: 3
      duration_mins: 5
    - type: p95_latency
      multiplier: 2.0
      duration_mins: 5
  sampling_ramp_minutes: 30
  action: rollback
```

caroline: I will take Flag scoping templates + docs. Plan: templates for internal, beta, prod with recommended scopes (region, customer_tier, feature_flag_percent). ETA: 1 week. Will add quickstart snippet for engineers. :thumbsup:

ashley: thanks — add a short checklist for product owners to force narrower scope defaults.

dmitri: I can add Canary health gates into the pipeline and the helm charts. Need to confirm which metrics to use for baseline—should we use 14-day baseline or rolling 3h? I vote rolling 3h for fast detection.
dmitri: ETA: 10 days, will drop PRs for CI stage gate + ops tests.

ashley: rolling 3h sounds right for fast regressions, but keep an option to use longer baselines for low-signal services. Noted.

eva: I'll own telemetry and dashboarding: add per-flag error rate, activation histogram, traffic split, and a burn-rate alert that ties into pager duty. ETA: 2 weeks. Will coordinate with Ben on what triggers to expose.

ashley: Ops runbook + kill-switch dashboard? who can take?

ben: I can stub the runbook with the rollback run steps. Need oncall to validate.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4821 -> "Auto-rollback policy spec" (assignee: ben, due: 2w).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4822 -> "Flag scoping templates" (assignee: caroline, due: 1w).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4823 -> "Canary health gate pipeline" (assignee: dmitri, due: 10d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4824 -> "Per-flag telemetry + burn-rate alerts" (assignee: eva, due: 2w).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4825 -> "Ops kill-switch dashboard + runbook" (assignee: ben, reviewer: oncall, due: 2w).

caroline: quick Q — do we want a standard naming convention for flags so dashboards can auto-group? e.g., service.feature.<name> :question:

dmitri: yes. Add prefix + environment tags. We can instrument Console to auto-populate groupings.

ben: one open design question: should auto-rollback be allowed for config flags that don't have easy rollback semantics? maybe restrict to toggles that are stateless and reversible. Add a flag metadata field "rollback_safe: true".

ashley: Agreed — add metadata schema: rollback_safe, preview_only, max_sample_pct. Caroline add this to templates.

eva: Also adding a gating alert to notify product owners before rollback (email + slack) so they can respond if it's a false positive. Rollback should be last-resort after 2 automated attempts? we can discuss.

ben: Implementation detail: we'll record every automated rollback as an event with {flag, scope, trigger, before_sample, after_action} so we can audit and tune thresholds.

ashley: Next steps: owners to update tickets with short scope + list of dependencies by EOD Friday. We'll reconvene Friday 09:30am to triage blockers. If anyone needs more time, ping now.

dmitri: noted, pinging infra for sampling evaluation quotas.

caroline: noted, I'll add naming + metadata fields to the template PR.

ben: starting design doc now, will @ashley when draft ready.

ashley: thanks all. small goal: reduce blast radius by default and get autorestore/autoremove safe by Q2 sprint.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync Fri 09:30 (channel: #eng-sre).
